attribution_limitations: Figures 2 and 3 captions say the CT scan covered the head, chest and abdomen, whereas the case text says neck, chest and abdomen.
Ultrasound size of about 9.0 × 9.2 cm differs from the CT size of about 18.4 × 14.8 × 13.6 cm; the source does not explain the difference.
Color Doppler absence of vascular supply is described as indicative of malignancy, whereas CT, intraoperative and histology statements describe a benign lipoma without malignant signs.
Table 1 lists a biopsy executed 18 days before surgery, but the main text describes histopathology of the resected specimen and names no preoperative biopsy site or result.
Table 1 gives relative times (for example 13 mo before, 4th day) without stating the reference point; surgery is listed at the 0th day.
CT describes internal septations causing compression and rising of the left kidney and spleen, yet the next statement says adjacent organs including the spleen and kidneys were not remarkable.
